signal_text: A Gumroad help center article (dated June 29, 2024) described membership product tiers as seller-configurable versions within a membership that support varying access levels, software license levels (e.g., Individual or Team), and add-on services such as coaching calls or community access.
subject_exact: Gumroad membership product tier structure for differentiated access levels, software licensing, and add-on services
extraction_notes: Membership tiers described as a seller-configurable feature. Software licensing example given (Individual vs Team). Coaching and community access as add-on tier examples. June 2024.
